title: [review] provisioning.py:355: Silent exception swallowing in
description: contextlib.suppress(Exception) swallows all errors from on_provisioned callback. If the callback fails (e.g., audit logging fails, database write fails), provisioning appears successful (returns CHANGED at line 365) but the provisioned identity may not be recorded. Security audit trails can be silently lost.
close_reason: Issue already fixed: exceptions from on_provisioned and on_new_identity callbacks now return INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR instead of being silently swallowed. Added regression tests: test_br_callback_exception_returns_internal_server_error and test_node_callback_exception_returns_internal_server_error.
